source_title: vivo S70's full camera details emerge in new leak
source_excerpt:
Last week, a rumour claimed that vivo was preparing to launch the S70 in China with a 64MP Sony periscope telephoto camera and support for a teleconverter. Now, a new leak has revealed the handset's complete camera specifications.
According to tipster Digital Chat Station, the vivo S70 will feature a 50MP primary rear sensor and an 8MP ultrawide camera alongside the 64MP periscope telephoto unit.
The tipster also revealed that the phone will feature a horizontally aligned large rear camera module, likely similar to the vivo S60 .
Other rumoured specifications of the vivo S70 include a 6.59-inch LTPS OLED display with 1.5K resolution and a Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset. The handset is also said to get a special edition themed around the game Sky: Children of the Light.
